scene: The flour bin opens, revealing a hidden transit junction full of exits.
picture: A flat side view inside the flour bin secret transit depot. On the far left, a woven bamboo cable car sits waiting with its hatch open. Left of centre, the woman in her red jacket and skates stands amazed. Up high, a moving escalator ascends through an opening. On the far right, a giant glowing paper-lantern balloon tugs gently at moorings.
shown: a woven bamboo cable car resting on a dock at the far left
a giant glowing paper-lantern hot air balloon anchored on the far right
a moving metal rooftop escalator stairs humming up high in the centre
